The engine replays one pool's swaps against the contract's range policy (RamsesRangeLib): oracle-centred range, matched-value
redeploy with no swap, cooldown, rolling daily limit, staleness and allocation gates, per-recentre loss bound. Its unit tests and
mutation checks live with the original. Extensions for this research are in ../engine_ext.py (subclass; the vendored file is not edited).
